Alex: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from the all-hands: can you clarify the timeline for the API/Console/Optimize items? Specifically: 1) Console: model-level canary rollouts + autoscale support — when can teams expect a GA? 2) API: are there any breaking changes planned for v2 of the sampling defaults? 3) Optimize: will the UI show quantization suggestions per-model or only at workload-level?
Maria: good Qs. tl;dr: staggered rollout. Console canary UI + basic autoscale is targeted for early Q3, GA end of Q3 if no major regressions. API sampling defaults change is a soft opt-in in Q2, not breaking. Optimize model-level suggestions planned for late Q3. More details in the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/roadmap/q3 (privileged access).
Chris: to add — backtopping priorities: reliability for hosted API > canary UX > Optimize UX. That means some Console features might appear in beta behind a flag while we finish infra work. We're tracking perf/regression via the eval suite before GA.
Alex: thanks — any chance we can get the canary + autoscale beta earlier for a few pilot teams? latency-sensitive apps would benefit.
Maria: yes, pilot access is the plan. I'll open a short signup form and invite platform teams. Expect an email tomorrow.
Lee: flagging: product office hours this Friday, 10am PT, to walk through the Console beta flows and the Optimize reporting changes. Join here: https://meet.redwood/po-office-hours. We'll demo the canary YAML + UI toggles.
Alex: perfect — can you paste the example canary policy we'll use in the demo? small snippet is fine.
Maria: sure — example snippet:```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  steps:
    - traffic: 5%
    - wait: 10m
    - traffic: 25%
    - wait: 30m
    - traffic: 100%
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  metric: p50_latency_ms
```
Alex: love it. one more on API: for the sampling default opt-in, will there be a compatibility shim for existing clients?
Chris: yes — we'll ship a `sampling_mode` param and keep the old behavior as `sampling_mode: legacy` for 6 months. New default will be `sampling_mode: balanced` for new integrations. We'll announce deprecation schedule in the changelog.
Maria: action items: 1) I'll share the full timeline + pilot signup by EOD tomorrow. 2) Product office hours Friday 10am PT (Lee to send invite). 3) Chris will publish the sampling_mode plan to #eng-api.
Lee: invite sent. calendar event includes a short pre-read (2 pages) and link to the demo workspace.
DeployBot: doc update: roadmap/q3 updated by Maria at 1767321500.
Alex: thanks all — appreciate the clarity. I'll route my team to the pilot signup and join Friday. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks — we'll monitor pilot feedback closely and iterate fast. :rocket:
